domain_invariants.requirement: All resource ids are immutable positive integers; non-positive path and referenced ids are treated as not found.
Properties have address 5..200, status ACTIVE or ARCHIVED, and one active assigned agent.
Agents have unique license_code ^[A-Z0-9-]{4,20}$, name 3..120, and active boolean.
Visits reference active property and agent with visitor_name 2..120 and UTC interval 15..240 minutes in 2025..2035.
An agent and a property cannot have overlapping SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN visits; intervals are half-open.
Visit transitions are SCHEDULED to CHECKED_IN or CANCELLED and CHECKED_IN to COMPLETED or CANCELLED; terminal history is retained.
Users own their visits; assigned agents and admins can view visits, while agents and properties are admin-managed.
All lists use deterministic ascending immutable id pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and after_id greater than zero, returning items and nullable next_after_id after filters.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; every other route requires a valid non-expired local Bearer session and is deny-by-default.
JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, wrong media type is 415, and valid JSON violating declared fields is 422.
The API is local and deterministic with no network, filesystem, upload, or external service. 503 and 500 leave all persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no authorization, accepting no input; it shall validate local persistence availability, probe only local persistence, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-6-009; preconditions: local persistence available.
    AUTHORIZE caller under the route policy OR RETURN 401 or 403. VALIDATE local persistence availability OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ only authorized matching data; RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: persistent state unchanged and all errors have no effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /properties/{property_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive property_id and JSON partial address, city, status, agent_id; it shall validate property and active agent fields, update supplied Property fields while preserving relations, perform the action atomically and be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

The system shall expose DELETE /properties/{property_id} to an authenticated user or admin, accepting a positive property_id; it shall validate property and active agent fields, soft-delete only an ARCHIVED property without visits, perform the deletion atomically, preserve or protect relations as stated, be non-idempotent, and return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, or 500.

The system shall expose GET /agents to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional declared filters, limit, and after_id; it shall validate agent fields and stable pagination, return an authorized stable page of agents, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, or 500.
